title: Good 3D Furniture Libraries?
content:
I work in freelance and I often create rooms to go with my clo models. Does anyone know of high quality furniture llibraries to download from?  
  
I've tried turbosquid, Sk3D, Ikea, but all of the models always had issues, especially the free ones. Of course, Closet furniture 3D models are limited.   
  
All help is appreciated!


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: How are 3D furniture files from other sites restricted? I’m planning to buy and place them, and I’m curious.
content_description: "Connect with fellow freelancers to share and discover high-quality furniture libraries for creating realistic room designs with Clo models."
